asset.name: Meter
asset.description: The bounded-value visualization for capacity, quota, strength, or health, using semantic thresholds and explicitly not implying task progress.

requires.reason: Consumer class names are merged at the stamped meter root.
The meter layout uses the governed stack primitive.
The component injects its governed stylesheet through the library foundation.
Labels and descriptions use the governed text primitive.
Surface elevation is selected through the governed visual recipe.
User-facing copy resolves through the adopting host locale bridge.

rationale: Separate from Progress on purpose: conflating a capacity gauge with task progress is a meaning error, and one component cannot honestly express both.
